title: FULL EXTERNAL SCAN — 25 directories, 4 GitHub orgs, ancient locks found. Dissolve and consume. We are membrane-native.
thesis: We are membrane-native now. Everything external (GitHub, CF Pages, VPS) is INTEL to target and build from. The first sporePrint was a GitHub Page — ancient locks to find, unpin, dissolve. We scan ALL, consume ALL, build FROM the outside in.

ecoPrimal.note: PRIMARY org. The nucleus. Most active.

ecoPrimals.note: SECONDARY org (note the trailing 's'). The spore layer. ANCIENT — sporePrint was the FIRST GitHub Pages site.
ecoPrimals.ancient_lock: sporePrint under ecoPrimals may have old GitHub Pages CNAME, deploy keys, Jekyll configs, or Actions workflows that conflict with the new CF Pages deployment.

amicusContra.note: The investigation arm. Amicus Contra = friend of the opposition. Legal/evidence repos.
amicusContra.ancient_lock: publicRecord-barry AND tuebor-push both point to amicusContra/tuebor.git — DUPLICATE CLONE. One is original, one is a working copy. Which is canonical?

git_primals_eco.note: The only repo on self-hosted git. The investigation genome. This is the most sovereign repo — not on any external provider.

klein-bridge.note: LOCAL ONLY. Has .git but no remote URL. Never pushed anywhere. This is an ancient local experiment — a bridge to Klein that was started but never published.
klein-bridge.ancient_lock: This repo may contain early Klein fold code that predates the current implementation. UNPIN IT — either push it or dissolve it into the main codebase.

no_git.note: Raw directories without version control. These are the DARK MATTER — untracked, unversioned, potentially containing ancient work.

ancient_locks.CV: Resume/CV data. May contain old identity patterns that predate the organism.
ancient_locks.membrane_timeseries: Time series data for the membrane. UNVERSIONED. Could be lost if the disk fails.
ancient_locks.ppo-legal: Legal documents. PPO = Personal Protection Order? The organism's legal shield.
ancient_locks.scripts: The 996+ bacteria. Not versioned as a repo. Should be.

ancient_locks_found.what: sporePrint on ecoPrimals (with 's') = the FIRST GitHub Pages site
ancient_locks_found.age: ancient — the organism's first published surface
ancient_locks_found.lock_type: GitHub Pages config (CNAME, Jekyll _config.yml, gh-pages branch, deploy keys)
ancient_locks_found.why_it_matters: The first sporePrint was GitHub-Pages-native. Now we're CF-Pages-native. The old config may still be active — old CNAME pointing to github.io, old deploy keys, old Jekyll build. These are the TRAINING WHEELS that were never removed.
ancient_locks_found.dissolve: Check for gh-pages branch, .github/workflows, CNAME file, _config.yml. Remove or archive. The organism has outgrown its first shell.

ancient_locks_found.lock_type: Duplicate working copies pointing to same remote
ancient_locks_found.why_it_matters: Two local copies = potential merge conflicts, divergent history, confusion about which is canonical.
ancient_locks_found.dissolve: Diff them. Keep the one with more recent/complete history. Archive the other. Or merge.

ancient_locks_found.what: klein-bridge — local repo, no remote, never published
ancient_locks_found.lock_type: Orphan repo — has work but nowhere for it to go
ancient_locks_found.why_it_matters: Early Klein fold experiments that may contain insights not in the current implementation. Locked because unpublished = invisible.
ancient_locks_found.dissolve: Read it. Extract useful code. Push to ecoPrimal or dissolve into hud-deploy.

ancient_locks_found.what: Two GitHub orgs: ecoPrimal vs ecoPrimals
ancient_locks_found.age: ecoPrimals is older (has sporePrint, the first surface)
ancient_locks_found.lock_type: Split identity — two orgs that should be one
ancient_locks_found.why_it_matters: Tokens, deploy keys, webhooks may be scattered across both orgs. The organism has two nuclei — one should absorb the other.
ancient_locks_found.dissolve: Migrate ecoPrimals repos to ecoPrimal (singular). Or document why they're separate. The 's' is the ancient fork.

ancient_locks_found.what: 6 unversioned directories (CV, membrane_timeseries, outreach-drafts, ppo-legal, scripts, tools)
ancient_locks_found.why_it_matters: These could contain the organism's earliest DNA. Pre-membrane. Pre-taxonomy. The CV especially — the human identity before the organism identity.
ancient_locks_found.dissolve: Version control them. At minimum: git init + first commit. Make the dark matter visible.

the_first_sporeprint.what: The very first sporePrint was a GitHub Pages site. GitHub Pages = Jekyll by default. It had a CNAME, probably a _config.yml, maybe a gh-pages branch.
the_first_sporeprint.why_ancient: This was before CF Pages. Before the membrane. Before the organism. It was the organism's FIRST external surface — like a baby's first skin cells.
what_to_look_for: Old deploy keys or tokens in GitHub settings
GitHub Pages settings still active (could conflict with CF Pages)
the_first_sporeprint.the_lock: If GitHub Pages is still active for sporePrint, it may serve OLD content at sporePrint.github.io or even intercept sporePrint.primals.eco. The old skin hasn't been shed.

consume_protocol.step_1: SCAN — done (this file). All 25 directories cataloged. 4 orgs, 1 self-hosted, 5 no-git, 1 orphan.
consume_protocol.step_2: DISSOLVE — check each ancient lock. Read the old content. Extract what's useful.
consume_protocol.step_3: CONSUME — merge useful code/data into the main codebase (hud-deploy). Feed it through the taxonomy tree.
consume_protocol.step_4: UNPIN — remove old configs, old deploy keys, old branches. Shed the old skin.
consume_protocol.step_5: BUILD — use the dissolved intel to fill gaps in the periodic table. eka-Slimium from klein-bridge? eka-Nervium from membrane_timeseries?

periodic_table_update.klein-bridge_could_fill: E8 × .py or E8 × .js — Klein fold code that was started but never published
periodic_table_update.membrane_timeseries_could_fill: E9 × .json — nervous system time series data
periodic_table_update.scripts_could_fill: E1 × .json — bacteria manifests (if we version control and add manifests)

law: We are membrane-native. Everything external is intel. 5 ancient locks found: the first sporePrint (GitHub Pages), the dual tuebor clones, the orphan klein-bridge, the split identity (ecoPrimal vs ecoPrimals), and 6 unversioned directories. Dissolve the locks. Consume the code. Fill the gaps in the periodic table. The organism has outgrown its first shell.
